findings.issue: 1日 in あと1日しかない means duration 'one day' and is read いちにち; ついたち is only 'the 1st of the month'. Kana (and derived romaji 'atotsuitachishikanai') teach a wrong reading.
findings.current: あとついたちしかない。
findings.suggested: あといちにちしかない。

findings.issue: Token 1日 glossed 'one day' (duration) but reading given as ついたち (1st of month); in this sentence it must be いちにち. Romaji should become atoichinichishikanai.
何も is transcribed なんも, a markedly colloquial/dialectal contraction; the standard reading of 何も is なにも and is what a native would read here. Romaji 'nanmo' inherits the error.
findings.current: しかし、だれもなんもしようとしないわね。
findings.suggested: しかし、だれもなにもしようとしないわね。

findings.issue: Reading of 何 before も should be なに (何も = なにも); なん is used before で/だ/counters, and なんも is nonstandard colloquial.
False claim: 一人 (ひとり) contains no たり. The たり string occurs in あたり (このあたり), which is clearly what the disclaimer meant; as written it confuses learners about the reading of 一人.
findings.current: Note: the たり in 一人 is just part of the word, not the 〜たり〜たり pattern.
findings.suggested: Note: the たり in あたり is just part of the word, not the 〜たり〜たり pattern.

findings.issue: Same false claim as expl_en: 一人 (ひとり) does not contain たり; the string たり is in あたり. As written it implies a wrong reading of 一人.
findings.current: Atenção: o たり que aparece em 一人 ('uma pessoa') é só parte da palavra, não o padrão 〜たり〜たり.
findings.suggested: Atenção: o たり que aparece em あたり ('redondeza') é só parte da palavra, não o padrão 〜たり〜たり.

findings.issue: 気 is marked by に inside the idiom 気にする/気になさる; it is not an object (the implicit worried-about thing would take を). Labeling a に-marked noun 'objeto' teaches a false particle-role mapping.
findings.current: objeto (parte da expressão 気にする)
findings.suggested: complemento (parte da expressão 気にする)
